posts.title: Core Image drops a JPEG XL’s alpha channel
posts.description: A JPEG XL image with an alpha channel, loaded by Core Image itself – CIImage(data:) or CIImage(contentsOf:) – comes out with alpha 1.0 everywhere (i.e. no transparency) ImageIO decodes the same file correctly (CGImageSourceCreateImageAtIndex gives a CGImage with alphaInfo == .last and the right alpha), and CIImage(cgImage:) of that is right. So that’s one workaround.… Read more

posts.title: UniFi Express 7 MLO breaks Apple AirPlay
posts.description: In UniFi / Ubiquiti’s defence, MLO is disabled by default and presents a warning in the settings when enabled: ⚠️ Although MLO can boost performance by combining bands, most WiFi 7 devices still operate on a single band — so any benefits may be limited.
